notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix – Prestige Skin & Buff Fixes
notes.notes:
We've fixed two issues related to prestige progression:

[list]
[*] Skins now correctly cycle based on your prestige level, preventing errors at higher levels.
[*] Prestige buffs were unintentionally stacking multiple times, causing inflated income. This has been corrected.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback and reports! 🛠️

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]More clarity, stronger clicks, and smoother progression![/h1]

[h2]🔍 Building Tooltips Now Show More Info[/h2]

Ever wondered what your buildings are really doing? Now you’ll see:
[list]
[*] Their base coin output
[*] Total production per second
[*] And how much they’ve earned over time
[/list]
Knowledge is profit!

[h2]🧑‍🎨 Player Level Display Improved[/h2]

To reduce confusion around prestige stars, we've added a clear level indicator below your avatar. You’ll still see your prestige symbol, but now your current level is also front and center.

[h2]👆 Click Upgrades Reworked[/h2]

Click upgrades now stack more effectively!
Instead of every level giving +100%, upgrades now scale like this:
+100%, +200%, +300%... up to +1000%
This makes each upgrade feel stronger and more rewarding.

[h2]🧬 Talent System Fixes & Balance Pass[/h2]

Fixed an issue where the Prestige Limit Reduction talent wasn’t working as intended.
All talents have been rebalanced for a smoother and more strategic progression.

[h2]🎨 Skin Update Fix[/h2]

Characters now properly update their skin when leveling up. Style and strength, all in one.

[h2]🧹 Miscellaneous UI Improvements[/h2]

We’ve cleaned up a few visual elements and polished the overall interface.


Thanks for playing Coin Smith and for all your feedback! This update brings better clarity, stronger upgrades, and a more satisfying idle experience. 💰✨
